Explanation: Opens the game window and starts the game. Main calls it.
Reads a scene file and adds everything in it to the game.
Draws the game with Vulkan. It must come before StartGame. Terrain, shadows, spotlights and other newer features need it.
Turns on physics in the 3D layer. Call it after LoadScene, because the scene sets physics on or off when it loads.
Asks the 3D layer to tell this object whenever two items start or stop touching.
Runs when two items start touching, such as a ball landing on the floor.
Runs when two items stop touching, such as a ball bouncing back up.
Starts playing a sound and lets the game keep running while it plays.

Quorum Code: SetGravity3D(number x, number y, number z)
Explanation: Sets which way, and how hard, things fall. -10 is about Earth's pull (9.8), straight down.
